# Art Lego LLC

> Licensed home remodeling and painting contractor serving St. Lucie County, Martin County, and parts of Palm Beach County, FL (including Wellington, FL 33414). General remodeling, kitchen and bathroom remodels, interior and exterior remodeling, residential and commercial painting.

Licensed contractor LIC#L19000206429. Phone: 561-574-3769 (secondary: 561-701-0455).

## Pages

- [Home](https://artlegoremodeling.com/): Overview of remodeling and painting services.
- [Remodeling](https://artlegoremodeling.com/remodeling): General, kitchen, bathroom, interior, and exterior remodeling.
- [Painting](https://artlegoremodeling.com/painting): Residential and commercial, interior and exterior painting.
- [About](https://artlegoremodeling.com/about): Company background and service approach.
- [Contact](https://artlegoremodeling.com/contact): Phone, service area, and free-estimate request form.
